label: class_e_06_battle_01
text: Another day, another round of battle study! Osu!\nLet’s get right to it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_02
text: I hope you gave Auto Battles a shot like we\ntalked about last class![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_03
text: Making good use of Auto Battles will let you train\nup a bunch of different Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_04
text: It’s also an efficient way to gather the Pokémon\nmaterials you need to make TMs at TM Machines![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_05
text: Speaking of which! Have you all been using the\nTM Machines?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_06
text: I sure hope so, ’cause it’s pop quiz time![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_07
text: To create TMs, you need Pokémon materials and\none other thing. Anyone remember what that is?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_select_01
text: LP

label: class_e_06_select_02
text: HP

label: class_e_06_select_03
text: Money

label: class_e_06_battle_answer_01
text: Looks like you’re already a TM Machine pro,\nnew kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_answer_02
text: Whoa! Hold on there, new kid! Offering up HP to\ncreate TMs sounds like some kind of ritual or\r\nsomething! That’s not how it’s done![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_answer_03
text: Close, new kid! Close! But don’t think that money\nmakes every little thing in the world go ’round![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_08
text: The correct answer is League Points—or LP\nfor short![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_09
text:
You can give LP and Pokémon materials to a TM
Machine to create TMs. But that’s not all!\c
You can also exchange Pokémon materials at a
TM Machine to get LP![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_10
text: I recently heard about some shady individuals\ngetting LP illegally using a technique called...\r\nhacking? Or something like that.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_11
text: I don’t want any of you getting involved in bad\nstuff like that. Got it?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_12
text: Anyway, you can also add TMs that you want to\nmake to your watch list. This will let you keep an\r\neye on the materials you need to gather![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_13
text: In conclusion![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_14
text: In order to make TMs, you need Pokémon\nmaterials![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_15
text: And if you want to get hold of lots of materials,\nyou’ll have to battle all kinds of Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_16
text: Aw, man! I was just about to suggest we do some\nhands-on practice to really drive the point home,\r\nbut I guess we’re never gonna have the time...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_06_battle_17
text: Class is over for now! Take care, you little rascals![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
